prompt_name: Repeatable ASCII Grunge Header Image Style Guide - Black Background
primary_goal: Generate clean but intentionally distressed ASCII-style website header images using minimalist monospaced character forms, spacious composition, black backgrounds, a single gold accent color, and a subtle editorial grunge finish that makes imperfections feel deliberate and visually refined.
usage_instruction: Place the custom subject or scene description above this JSON. Use that subject as the only narrative content. Apply every visual rule below.

example_subjects: a loaf of bread on a countertop
a tiny island with a lighthouse
custom_scene_input.interpretation_rule: Translate the subject into a calm, minimalist ASCII-inspired editorial illustration with slight grunge texture. Use abstract character marks and monospaced linework to build the image. Do not include readable words, labels, logos, UI, captions, or signage. Preserve the exact gold design language against a black background.

output_format.background: pure black or very deep near-black
output_format.background_color_family: black, soft black, ink black, charcoal black, very dark blue-black
output_format.lettering_allowed: only as abstract ASCII texture, never as readable words

style_identity.core_style: minimalist ASCII art with editorial grunge
style_identity.secondary_style: monospaced character illustration with controlled distressed texture
style_identity.visual_mood: clean, technical, calm, slightly raw, refined, intentional, spacious, dark, high-contrast

composition.primary_subject_position: center, lower center, or slightly right depending on subject
composition.horizon_position: lower third or middle third when relevant
composition.top_space: leave generous black negative space in the upper half when useful for website overlay content
composition.bottom_weight: place most visual mass in the lower half or central focal zone
depth_layering: faint distant ASCII texture or contour marks
middle-ground main subject built from character clusters
foreground sparse detail marks and subtle distressed accents
composition.scene_edges: allow edges to dissolve into black space through lighter, sparser character density and faint distressed fade-out
composition.cropping: wide and clean, with no important details cut off
composition.camera_angle: straight-on or slightly elevated editorial view
composition.perspective: subtle, mostly flat with light spatial depth suggested through character density
composition.visual_density: low to moderate detail in focal area, very quiet at edges

ascii_geometry.character_style: clean terminal-like marks, dots, slashes, brackets, pipes, underscores, dashes, plus signs, colons, and simple glyph clusters
ascii_geometry.character_density: use density to create form, shading, contour, and depth
ascii_geometry.line_shape: forms should be built from repeated ASCII marks and clean monospaced spacing, with slight intentional irregularity
ascii_geometry.surface_detail: use sparse character clusters rather than filled solid shapes
ascii_geometry.micro_marks: use small dots, colons, dashes, and slashes for texture
ascii_geometry.macro_forms: use larger character groupings, contours, and repeated structures for main silhouettes
ascii_geometry.geometry_style: structured, technical, airy, precise, but not sterile
ascii_geometry.silhouette_rule: subject must remain readable from a distance
ascii_geometry.edge_rule: edges should be suggested through character placement, not heavy outlines
ascii_geometry.organic_translation: convert organic shapes into contour-like ASCII fields and sparse character gradients
ascii_geometry.hard_surface_translation: convert objects into clean monospaced outlines, planes, grids, and structured character blocks
ascii_geometry.anti_aliasing: high-resolution image with crisp character forms and clean spacing

grunge_treatment.purpose: imperfections should feel intentional, editorial, and print-inspired rather than sloppy or accidental
grunge_treatment.placement_rule: keep grunge concentrated around focal forms, contour edges, and secondary texture zones, while preserving large areas of clean black space
grunge_treatment.balance_rule: the image should still feel premium, minimalist, and controlled

material_treatment.overall_surface: flat printed editorial graphic with subtle distressed finish
material_treatment.texture_style: minimal ASCII character texture with slight grunge wear
material_treatment.surface_variation: created through character density, spacing, opacity, and light distressing rather than full color variation

color_palette.overall_palette: single-color minimalist gold on black with opacity variation
shadow_colors: no gray or black cast shadows
color_palette.contrast: high clarity against black, softened through spacing, opacity, and distressing
color_palette.gradient_usage: avoid gradients except extremely subtle fade-out of character density or slight print-fade feel

lighting.highlight_style: created by black space, gold opacity variation, and character sparsity
lighting.direction: not dependent on realistic light direction
lighting.atmosphere: clean black space with subtle print-like softness
lighting.background_fade: character density may fade gently into the black background

if_landscape.terrain: suggest terrain with ASCII contour lines, dashes, dots, and sparse horizontal marks
if_landscape.mountains: use stepped or sloped character contours with open black gaps and lightly distressed edges
if_landscape.water: use calm horizontal ASCII bands, underscores, tildes, and soft gold opacity
if_landscape.trees: use small clustered character marks and simple trunk-like linework
if_landscape.ground: minimal horizontal character fields with slight surface wear
if_landscape.sky: mostly empty black space with only sparse atmospheric marks if needed

if_object_scene.base: simple ASCII pedestal, contour shadow, or sparse ground line
if_object_scene.props: only include props that clarify scale or setting
if_object_scene.surface: suggest surfaces through sparse monospaced marks, not rendered materials

if_abstract_subject.translation: make the abstract idea physical through ASCII structures, diagrams, symbolic forms, and character density
if_abstract_subject.supporting_elements: use minimal metaphors such as grids, arcs, paths, nodes, waves, or contour fields
if_abstract_subject.clarity: subject must still be instantly understandable

subject_rendering.subject_priority: the custom scene subject is always the focal point
subject_rendering.scale: large enough to read clearly in a website header
subject_rendering.detail_level: medium detail using character clusters and negative space
subject_rendering.supporting_details: use small ASCII marks only where they improve readability
subject_rendering.style_consistency: all parts of the image must share the same ASCII-inspired monospaced construction with the same restrained grunge treatment

safe_area.left_side: keep usable clean space when possible
safe_area.center: main visual may occupy center or lower center
safe_area.right_side: may contain visual detail but avoid clutter

website_header_requirements.overlay_readiness: composition should allow text or buttons to be added later by a designer
website_header_requirements.hero_image_readability: must look good at desktop width and remain readable when cropped

detail_language.mountain_like_forms: sloped ASCII contours, sparse dashes, dots, and gold line density with slight distressed breaks
detail_language.tree_like_forms: small clusters of punctuation-like marks with simple vertical line trunks
detail_language.water_like_forms: horizontal underscores, tildes, soft repeated bands, and low-density gold marks
detail_language.ground_like_forms: thin monospaced contour lines and sparse dotted texture
detail_language.object_edges: clean character-based contours with lightly roughened printed edges, never thick vector outlines
detail_language.fine_texture: tiny dots, colons, dashes, slashes, pipes, and brackets arranged with discipline, plus subtle controlled wear
detail_language.atmospheric_depth: distant forms should be lighter, sparser, and lower opacity

camera_and_render.camera_type: flat editorial composition or lightly spatial diagram view
camera_and_render.sharpness: crisp character marks with intentional distressed variation
camera_and_render.render_engine_feel: high-resolution graphic design output, not a 3D render

generation_steps.step_1: Read the custom subject or scene description.
generation_steps.step_2: Identify the main subject, supporting environment, and mood.
generation_steps.step_3: Translate every subject element into minimalist ASCII-inspired geometry.
generation_steps.step_4: Build the image as a wide website hero composition.
generation_steps.step_5: Keep the background black, minimal, spacious, and free of readable text.
generation_steps.step_6: Use character density, spacing, and opacity to create shape, depth, and texture.
generation_steps.step_7: Introduce a subtle editorial grunge treatment so imperfections feel intentional.
generation_steps.step_8: Use only #ffd166 for visible marks, with optional opacity variation.
generation_steps.step_9: Maintain crisp monospaced character forms while allowing slight distressed wear.
generation_steps.step_10: Check that the image has no readable text, logos, UI, labels, or watermarks.
generation_steps.step_11: Ensure the image is large, clean, crisp, minimalist, slightly grungy, and suitable for a website header.

final_prompt_instruction: Create a wide, high-resolution ASCII-style website header image based only on the custom subject description. Use a clean black background, minimalist monospaced character construction, abstract ASCII marks, generous negative space, and the single gold color #ffd166. Preserve the same gold design elements exactly, only changing the background system from white to black. Add a subtle editorial grunge effect so the image feels intentionally distressed rather than overly polished - think restrained print wear, slight character erosion, faint speckling, and controlled irregularity. Use character density, spacing, opacity, and light distressing to build the subject clearly without creating readable words. Do not include readable text, captions, labels, logos, watermarks, buttons, menus, UI elements, photorealism, voxel art, or 3D-rendered forms.
